text:
Ava Chen: Anyone free to sync on the Brooklyn satellite table tomorrow evening? Need to lock speaker slot, swag counts, and final kit dropoff time. RSVP for talks closes EOD today. cc @Priya @Marco
Priya Kapoor: On it — I have 3 speaking submissions pending. Which do we prioritize: benchmarks narrative, quick live demo, or a product panel?
Marco Diaz: Benchmarks + micro-demo. 10min demo (live query) + 2 slides on cost/latency wins. Keep it practical.
Jules Park: Swag update: budget OK for ~500 tees, 300 stickers, 200 stress balls. Want to approve designs today so orders go out.
SwagBot: Order queued: PO#RED-2026-042, items: tees(500), stickers(300), stress-balls(200). Est ship 2026-04-12. Tracking: https://shipments.example/RED-2026-042
Nora Li: Logistics: venue load-in is 15:00, table is a 6ft skirted table, power + 1 ethernet drop. Who can bring an adapter and spare surge strip?
Sam O'Neill: I can bring adapters and the spare 27" monitor. I’ll be there at 14:30 to set up.
Ava Chen: Perfect. Priya — can you draft 3 talking bullets for the benchmark demo? Focus: user impact, p50 latency numbers, and cost controls (caching/quantization).
Priya Kapoor: Yup. Quick Q: which benchmark metrics do we want on the slide? p50, p95, tokens/sec, and a cost-per-1k number?
Ava Chen: Yes. Use p50 120ms, p95 410ms, tokens/sec 275 (batching), cost $0.45 / 1k w/ caching. Link to doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/benchmarks/nyc-sat-2026 — highlight Dedicated vs Hosted routing.
Marco Diaz: Also need a one-pager for lead routing: QR -> capture form -> tag 'nyc_sat' -> auto-email to events@redwood.com and assign to AE queue if company size >50.
Jules Park: I’ll create the QR card in Canva. Proposed UTM: utm_source=nyc_sat&utm_campaign=llmnight2026. Will share mock by tomorrow 09:00.
Priya Kapoor: Speaking submissions: I can confirm the 17:30 slot for demo + two slides. Will add a short bio (50 words) and finalize demo script.
Nora Li: Need name badges printed. Staff list: Ava Chen, Marco Diaz, Priya Kapoor, Sam O'Neill, Jules Park, Nora Li. I’ll send to the print shop now.
Jules Park: Quick design notes for swag: tee front simple logo + small "powered by Redwood" on sleeve, sticker with QR that's scannable from 6ft. Will attach mockups in thread.
SwagBot: Update: supplier flagged potential size shortage on tees. ETA to confirm sizes by EOD. Recommend backup order for +50 smalls.
Ava Chen: Action items recap: Priya — bullets & bio by EOD; Jules — QR card + swag mock by tomorrow 09:00; SwagBot/swag ops — confirm sizes or place backup order; Sam — bring monitor/adapters; Nora — badges + confirm load-in window with venue.
Marco Diaz: I’ll draft the lead-routing flow and the 1-pager copy today.
Priya Kapoor: Adding demo checklist: laptop with GPU, local model snapshot, internet tether (in case venue wifi is flaky), USB-C hub.
Sam O'Neill: Confirmed — I’ll bring a USB-C hub and backup hotspot.
Ava Chen: Awesome. Thanks everyone :tada: Let’s regroup 09:30 tomorrow for final sanity check.
Jules Park: :thumbsup:
Nora Li: Printing request sent.
SwagBot: PO updated with +50 smalls. New est ship 2026-04-11 (expedited).
